question: How long is the Initial Enrollment Period for Medicare when you turn 65?
true_option: Seven months — the three months before your 65th birthday month, that month, and the three months after
false_option: Three months — it ends the month you turn 65
true_claim_text: the Medicare Initial Enrollment Period is seven months around your 65th birthday
false_claim_text: the Medicare Initial Enrollment Period is only three months ending at your birthday
source: CMS / Medicare.gov, 'When does Medicare coverage start?': the Initial Enrollment Period is 7 months — it begins 3 months before the month you turn 65 and ends 3 months after that month.
